build_system: go build for engine, npm scripts for CMS
verification_instructions: 1. Run go build ./... from engine/ to verify compilation. 2. Run go test ./internal/config/... ./internal/httpapi/... from engine/ for unit tests. 3. Run npm run build from cms/ to verify Strapi builds. 4. Verify SQL syntax by reading migration files (no live DB required for Phase 1).
environment_constraints: Go 1.26+ required. Node 22.x for CMS. No live database required for Phase 1 implementation.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style: pgxpool for Postgres, chi-style URL params via r.PathValue(), JSON encoding patterns from pgstore.go. CMS content types follow Strapi 5 schema format.

key_patterns.store_pattern: PgStore in internal/config/pgstore.go: withTx for transactions, classifyPg for error mapping, singleflight for cache miss collapse
key_patterns.admin_api_pattern: handlers in internal/httpapi/admin_handlers.go: decodeJSON, writeJSON, writeError helpers, a.fail for error mapping, r.PathValue for URL params
key_patterns.migration_pattern: migrations/000N_name.up.sql and .down.sql files, registered in migrations/migrations.go

directory_structure.engine/internal/config: Config store seam: memStore, PgStore, cache, codecs. Group types and store methods go here.
directory_structure.engine/internal/httpapi: HTTP handlers: server.go wires routes, admin.go/admin_handlers.go for admin API. New admin_groups.go for group endpoints.
directory_structure.engine/migrations: SQL migrations: 000N_name.up.sql/.down.sql. migrations.go registers them for embed.
directory_structure.cms/src/api: Strapi content types: each has content-types/, controllers/, routes/, services/ subdirs.
directory_structure.cms/src/components: Strapi reusable components: connection/, flow/, webhook/ categories.
